output_list.reason: The adminClaimAirdrop function allows the owner to arbitrarily distribute tokens to any address, excluding the owner from the airdrop distribution. This can be exploited to create a rational exclusion of the owner from the airdrop, allowing the owner to steal tokens from the airdrop recipients.

The getTokens function allows users to buy tokens with Ether, but it does not check if the totalSupply overflows uint256, causing an integer overflow and allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the total supply of tokens.

The distr function allows the owner to distribute tokens to any address, but it does not check if the balances overflow uint256, causing an integer overflow and allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the balances of recipients.

The doAirdrop function allows the owner to airdrop tokens to any address, but it does not check if the totalDistributed overflows uint256, causing an integer overflow and allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the totalDistributed.

The adminClaimAirdropMultiple function allows the owner to airdrop tokens to multiple addresses in a single transaction, but it does not check if the totalDistributed overflows uint256, causing an integer overflow and allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the totalDistributed.
